Definition: from G2095 and the base of G4591; well indicated, i.e. (figuratively) significant:--easy to be understood.
BiblicalUsage: eúsēmos means easy to be understood. In 1 Corinthians 14:9, the text says "except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of eúsēmos I do not force more than it gives: easy to be understood.
